title: Iraq gimbal thermal video by Marine
place_text: Iraqi desert, ~100 miles from Syrian border

tellings.quote: Um but I'll just tee it up first. Jeremy got an interview with the the Marine who actually recorded this. This was a in 2008. Uh and he's in a what's called a LAV Lav 25.

plain: In 2008 a US Marine riding in a LAV-25, a light armoured vehicle, is said to have filmed an unexplained object on a thermal camera in the Iraqi desert, about 100 miles from the Syrian border. The footage is compared to "Gimbal", a well-known Navy infrared clip of an unexplained object. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff brings it up on the show, in a debate with the skeptic Mick West, and says the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell has interviewed the Marine who recorded it.
